integrity: A fully specified analytic proof accompanies exact rational and finite numerical reproducibility checks. The finite checks are not substitutes for arbitrary-dimensional proof; no independent audit, authorship claim, or external validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Global comparison proved only for pairs each with at most two spectral values; all-dimensional noncommutative case proved, but no arbitrary-spectrum norm comparison is asserted. Exact Frobenius equality conditions do not extend as stated to other symmetric norms. Previously established two-by-two theorem and spectral-cardinality counterexample are credited; absolute novelty against unindexed mathematical literature is not certified.
title: Two-spectral crossed-Heinz majorization and exact commutator stability
